summary: Maximum vertical architecture. A heavy-duty, carbon steel curler designed to fit the exact curvature of the human eye without pinching.
description: Structural lash bending. Engineered with a specialized silicone pad, this tool applies perfectly calibrated pressure to crimp and lift the lash fibers upward, dramatically opening the visual architecture of the eye.
technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 1 Unit, this KoColor EYELASH_CURLER is expertly formulated with Carbon Steel and High-Density Silicone Pads. It delivers a high-fidelity Rose Gold color profile (`#B76E79`) and leverages calibrated mechanical leverage.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Look down, position the curler at the absolute base of the upper lashes, and pulse the pressure 3 times.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Heat the silicone pad with a hairdryer for 5 seconds before curling. The thermal transfer acts like a curling iron, locking the structure into place for 24 hours.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: High-density silicone ensures the pad will never slice or sheer off the eyelashes, a common failure point in cheap rubber curlers.
